measures.name: Condition
measures.expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('RealTimeData'[location]), VAR t = MAX('RealTimeData'[recorded_at]) RETURN CALCULATE(MIN('RealTimeData'[weather_desc]), 'RealTimeData'[recorded_at] = t), "")

measures.name: Temp Card
measures.expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('RealTimeData'[location]), VAR v = IF(SELECTEDVALUE('Units'[unit], "Imperial") = "Metric", AVERAGE('RealTimeData'[temperature_2m]), AVERAGE('RealTimeData'[temperature_2m_f])) RETURN FORMAT(v, "#,0.0") & IF(SELECTEDVALUE('Units'[unit], "Imperial") = "Metric", " °C", " °F"), "")

measures.name: Wind Card
measures.expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('RealTimeData'[location]), VAR v = IF(SELECTEDVALUE('Units'[unit], "Imperial") = "Metric", AVERAGE('RealTimeData'[wind_speed_10m]), AVERAGE('RealTimeData'[wind_speed_10m_mph])) RETURN FORMAT(v, "#,0.0") & IF(SELECTEDVALUE('Units'[unit], "Imperial") = "Metric", " km/h", " mph"), "")

measures.name: CC Message
measures.expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('RealTimeData'[location]), "", "Please select a city on the map to view local weather conditions.")

measures.name: Condition Icon
measures.expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('RealTimeData'[location]), VAR t = MAX('RealTimeData'[recorded_at]) VAR d = CALCULATE(MIN('RealTimeData'[weather_desc]), 'RealTimeData'[recorded_at] = t) RETURN SWITCH(TRUE(), CONTAINSSTRING(d, "thunder"), UNICHAR(9928) & UNICHAR(65039), CONTAINSSTRING(d, "snow") || CONTAINSSTRING(d, "freezing"), UNICHAR(127784) & UNICHAR(65039), CONTAINSSTRING(d, "drizzle") || CONTAINSSTRING(d, "rain") || CONTAINSSTRING(d, "shower"), UNICHAR(127783) & UNICHAR(65039), CONTAINSSTRING(d, "fog"), UNICHAR(127787) & UNICHAR(65039), CONTAINSSTRING(d, "overcast"), UNICHAR(9729) & UNICHAR(65039), CONTAINSSTRING(d, "cloud"), UNICHAR(9925), CONTAINSSTRING(d, "mainly clear"), UNICHAR(127780) & UNICHAR(65039), CONTAINSSTRING(d, "clear") || CONTAINSSTRING(d, "sun"), UNICHAR(9728) & UNICHAR(65039), ""), "")

measures.name: City Lat
measures.expression: SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE('RealTimeData'[location]), "Denver",39.73915, "Colorado Springs",38.83388, "Pueblo",38.25445, "Leadville",39.25082, "Fort Collins",40.58526, "Durango",37.27528, "Grand Junction",39.06387, "Glenwood Springs",39.55054, "Steamboat Springs",40.48498, "Castle Rock",39.27, "Longmont",40.27, "Boulder",40.06, "Trinidad",37.16946, "Sterling",40.62554, "Dinosaur",40.24358, "Cortez",37.34888, "Walsh",37.38613)

measures.name: City Long
measures.expression: SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE('RealTimeData'[location]), "Denver",-104.98470, "Colorado Springs",-104.82136, "Pueblo",-104.60914, "Leadville",-106.29252, "Fort Collins",-105.08442, "Durango",-107.88007, "Grand Junction",-108.55065, "Glenwood Springs",-107.32478, "Steamboat Springs",-106.83172, "Castle Rock",-104.55, "Longmont",-104.55, "Boulder",-105.65, "Trinidad",-104.50054, "Sterling",-103.20771, "Dinosaur",-109.01456, "Cortez",-108.58593, "Walsh",-102.27824)
